source_data: 12 archived development seeds, family and coefficient changes, k=1,3,10, old 2560-example source library
reference: Archived uniform-allocation warm-start errors at 200 target examples, exactly matched by seed, change type, changed count, and node
primary_question: Can a guaranteed floor retain adaptive warm-start changed-node benefits while keeping untouched-node error no more than 1.05 times uniform warm error?
development_gate: For a floor to merit new systems: family-change changed-node adaptive-warm/uniform-warm ratio <=0.8 at k=1,3,10; family and coefficient unchanged-node ratio <=1.05 at every k; coefficient-change changed-node ratio <=1.05 at every k. The protected source switch remains a separate unpromoted diagnostic.
interpretation: These reused development systems cannot support a confirmatory claim. Passing the gate only justifies a fresh-system protocol; failing both floors ends this specific floor adjustment.
forbidden: No Azure or other closed-source model API, no non-ACE job modification, no using changed-node labels in acquisition
